cases.input_description: Two dry and one content per NP; coherent provenance and OUTs
cases.expected: select original first content, keep adoption false; no rerun

cases.input_description: Start Unknown/None, CANCELLED, no ledger row
cases.expected: excluded before start

cases.input_description: ExitCode 3:0, zero attempt, coherent optional prestop row
cases.expected: excluded, preserve reason

cases.input_description: ExitCode 3:0 plus attempt row
cases.expected: mismatch; no conclusion

cases.input_description: rc4, one attempt, all NOT_COMPUTED, partial OUT accounted for
cases.expected: count one technical attempt; no content selection; no automatic retry

cases.input_description: Two distinct attempts, first all NOT_COMPUTED, second content, identical fixed sources
cases.expected: select second as first content; attempt count2; hypothetical only

cases.input_description: One content cell and another NOT_COMPUTED
cases.expected: freeze this first content attempt; missing required cell means no corresponding conclusion

cases.input_description: First content FAIL or wrong prediction
cases.expected: freeze; no same-registration retry for a better outcome

cases.input_description: Later content after first content, even different folder
cases.expected: violation; never replace first selected attempt

cases.input_description: Three N40000 attempts for same NP
cases.expected: over cap; new registration required; no conclusion

cases.input_description: An attempt in ledger has no returned OUT/failure evidence
cases.expected: mismatch; missing evidence not silently dropped

cases.input_description: Same job has two attempt rows
cases.expected: mismatch even if honest recovery; do not deduplicate

cases.input_description: Ledger job absent from returned scheduler population
cases.expected: unresolved; no conclusion

cases.input_description: Started non-rc3 scheduler job absent from attempt ledger
cases.expected: mismatch; no conclusion

cases.input_description: Matching PENDING/RUNNING job at collection
cases.expected: incomplete collection; no final qualification

cases.input_description: attempt N39900 or NP3 or ledger NP differs from scheduler name
cases.expected: mismatch; no conclusion

cases.input_description: prestop-only row with ExitCode4:0
cases.expected: mismatch, not a counted clean preflight

cases.input_description: Torn/malformed ledger line, conflicting fields or exact repeated line
cases.expected: reject rather than repair or drop

cases.input_description: Source pin/deck/runner/comparator/binary/MPI identity differs across selected NP records
cases.expected: mixing gate fails; no partial conclusion

cases.input_description: No restart-count field; expired live record; bounded -D population
cases.expected: bounded evidence only; do not assert universal absence

cases.input_description: Same cluster/job with distinct DBIndex or inconsistent chronology
cases.expected: retain both records; ambiguity/requeue investigation; not normal merged record

cases.input_description: Accounting or operator record shows requeue before first attempt
cases.expected: independent history required; single ledger row is insufficient

cases.input_description: OUT alias maps to different actual file or mapping is not established
cases.expected: binding unresolved; do not use path spelling as proof

cases.input_description: Files change after STOP or retrieval hash differs from fixed return
cases.expected: retain evidence, no complete-result promotion
